title: agentkit plugin manifest
description: Declares the third-party plugin collection. Each key is a plugin name chosen here; it names the local checkout under ~/.local/share/ai-agent-config/plugins/<name> and identifies the plugin when enabling native installs.

repository.description: Required. Single source of truth for the plugin. Used for the local checkout (upstream HEAD), for `plugin marketplace add` on fresh installs, and as the pip source when `cli` is set.

marketplace.description: Marketplace name the vendor declared inside their repo (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json or .agents/plugins/marketplace.json). Presence means: install as a native plugin in Codex and Claude Code via `plugin add <name>@<marketplace>`.

skills.description: Relative path to a folder of SKILL.md directories inside the plugin. Those skills are linked into tools without native plugin support and used as fallback when a native install fails.

opencode.description: Relative path of the OpenCode plugin inside the repository, registered in opencode.json. Use "." when the repository root is the plugin.

companion.description: Folder in this repository holding agentkit skills that install only when this plugin is selected. They are linked like the skills in skills/ and are not part of the agentkit plugin-only install.

cli.description: The repository is a Python package providing a command. The installer keeps any existing executable, otherwise installs it into an isolated venv and links it into ~/.local/bin.

description.description: One-line role, shown when the installer asks which plugins to install and in error listings.
